title: Tension at lowest point
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be 1080 N or derived from F = (3 - 2cosα)mg.

title: Energy conservation for velocity
description: Important Criteria: Applies work-energy theorem mgL(1-cosα) = ½mv² to find speed at lowest point.

title: Circular motion force balance
description: Important Criteria: Uses Newton's second law F - mg = mv²/L at the lowest point.

title: Horizontal landing distance
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly calculated from projectile motion.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important Criteria: Correctly calculates free-fall time from H-L = ½gt² and horizontal displacement x = vt.

title: Depth of water entry
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (3) must be 1.2 m or derived from energy balance with buoyancy.

title: Energy balance with forces
description: Important Criteria: Applies work-energy theorem mg(H-Lcosα+d) = (f₁+f₂)d for motion in water.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall Criteria: Uses incorrect sign for buoyant/resistance forces in energy equation (should be opposing motion).

title: Trigonometric value substitution
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrectly substitutes sin53°=0.8 or cos53°=0.6 in calculations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Maintains consistent units (kg, m, s, N) throughout all calculations.
